1. FM creates Tenant (server/routes/user.js manual-create and/or invite flow)
2. Tenant creates Staff (manual-create with managerId, and/or companyCode register flow)

Facial Recognition automatic process:
7. POST /api/facial-recognition/recognize resolves identity by unique user ID from PostgreSQL (DB authoritative for name/role/account state, never AI metadata)
8. Gate Scanner → POST /api/attendance/scan creates/toggles Attendance (verifyServiceOrRole('FM'))
9. V-Patrol → POST /api/facial-recognition/access-event writes audit log only, never Attendance
10. Unknown/suspended users create deduplicated SecurityLogs (server-side dedup window); no-face frames create NO suspicious log
11. Confirm the browser never calls FastAPI directly (grep client/src for 8501 or FACE_AI)

Smart Logistics manual CRUD (server/routes/booking.js + client TenantLogistics.jsx):
12. Create booking (POST /api/bookings/create), read role-scoped (GET /api/bookings/ scoping by role/tenantId), edit (PATCH /api/bookings/:id), soft-cancel (PATCH /:id/cancel sets status Cancelled, no hard delete)

Smart Logistics automatic process:
13. Unique booking_ref generation, QR / public Driver Pass (GET /api/bookings/:ref safe DTO), WhatsApp real-or-simulated (services/whatsappService.js WHATSAPP_ENABLED flag), gate entry→Arrived / exit→Completed (PATCH /:ref/gate-scan), next-in-line notification after completion.
